Since 2014

A home bakery that grew up, and finally got a store.

Bake My Day began in 2014 as a home bakery taking orders over WhatsApp. The tins did the travelling first, building an audience of 105,893 followers on Instagram before there was a shop to walk into.

In the first week of November 2026, that changed. The brand soft opened its first ever physical store at The Grand, Nad Al Sheba Gardens, proudly homegrown and now baking in person.

The tin opens here.

Keep scrolling. The Cookie Doughish tin that went viral, layer by layer, the way everyone in Dubai seems to have met it: lid first, then the good part.
